avis.titre: A Game-Changer for Even Skin Tone and UV Protection!
avis.texte: I've been using Kiehl's TREATMENTS Auto-Tone Discoloration & UV Solution for several weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. My skin tone has visibly evened out, and stubborn dark spots from past sun exposure are fading faster than I expected. The formula feels lightweight and absorbs quickly—no greasy residue, no pilling under makeup. One of my favorite features is the built-in UV protection. It saves me a step in the morning routine and gives peace of mind knowing my skin is being protected while it's healing. The serum is also fragrance-free and gentle, which is perfect for my sensitive skin. Overall, this is an excellent multitasking product for anyone dealing with discoloration, uneven skin tone, or looking to prevent future sun damage. Kiehl's has nailed it with this one!

I've been using the Auto-Tone Skin Discoloration Treatment with SPF 30 for about six weeks now, and overall, I'm impressed with its performance, especially as a dual-purpose product targeting uneven skin tone while offering daily sun protection. From a formulation standpoint, it includes key brightening ingredients like niacinamide and tranexamic acid, which are well-regarded in dermatology for treating hyperpigmentation. Many users online also praise its lightweight texture and how well it layers under makeup. I noticed my dark spots (especially from post-acne) beginning to fade within three weeks, though more stubborn areas took longer. It didn't cause irritation or breakouts, which is a big plus since my skin can be reactive. What sets it apart is the inclusion of SPF 30, which is crucial because any brightening treatment without sun protection is less effective — sun exposure often worsens discoloration. The sunscreen isn't greasy or chalky, making it great for daily wear. However, it's not a miracle product. While it noticeably improved overall tone and reduced some patchiness, deep melasma or longstanding sun spots may need something stronger or more targeted. Also, the price point is a bit high, which may not suit all budgets.

I use a mattifying primer to help with excess oil. I recently noticed a huge patch of lightened skin on my face. I have never had that show up before. The only thing new in my routine is this cream. So think the melasyl claim works. I wish it would have been an even color correction on my face. If you don't mind the greasy feel and are looking for tone correction cream, id suggest giving this a try. I won't be purchasing this again as I like an event skin tone be it light or pigmented.

avis.titre: It's ok just not for me
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this product when it came in the mail. As a woman with a darker complexion, I struggle to find a sunscreen that doesn't make me look like a ghost. I've been using this sunscreen for a little a week now and never had any ghost effect. Actually it melted into my skin perfectly in less than a minute of massaging. It definitely did a good job with blocking out UV rays. Been out in the sun multiple times for an expended period of time and never got sunburn so that's definitely a plus. However, this product is not ideal for those with oily/acne prone skin. Unfortunately, I do have oily skin and I just end up looking like a glazed donut which clogged my pours. Also, I usually have a skin care routine which consist of both active and inactive ingredients. It seemed to burn/ sting my skin if I combine this product ontop of my serums/ moisturizer, so I would be careful if you have sensitive skin and layering with this product. As far as evening skin tone, I haven't noticed a difference at all. Not even with lightening my dark spots, so I wouldn't expect any major difference in that department. Overall, it's ok. I would recommend this product unless you have sensitive/oily/acne prone skin.
This product is good so far (used 1 week). Haven't seen improvements on lightening my acne scars but other than that I love that it's lightweight. No complaints, high hopes for this.

avis.titre: Skincare gem that delivers on its promises!
avis.texte: I've struggled with dark spots and uneven skin tone for years, but after discovering Kiehl's Auto-Tone Discoloration & UV Solution, my skin has undergone a remarkable transformation. I was skeptical at first, having tried various products without seeing significant results. But this serum surprised me. Within a week or two of using it morning and night, I noticed my dark spots fading, and my skin looked brighter and smoother. What I love most about this product is its gentle yet effective formula. A little goes a long way, and it absorbs beautifully, leaving my skin feeling silky and supple. I apply it after cleansing, before moisturizing, and it's become an essential part of my daily skincare routine. This serum has exceeded my expectations. The results speak for themselves – my skin looks radiant, and I've received countless compliments. If you're searching for a reliable, affordable, and gentle solution to discoloration and dark spots, look no further. Kiehl's Auto-Tone Discoloration & UV Solution is a game-changer.
